summary:
I played the four new features (weekly to-do, outside garden, set collection, gift box) in a touch browser at 320x568, 360x740 and 412x915 against /home/user/ppolppol-merge (c451d09) and found no "must" defect: nothing crashes in normal play, no saved data is corrupted, no console error or failed request appeared in any run, and the core rules hold. All twelve task kinds count exactly once per real action (39 of 39 checks by real play), re-roll obeys its rules over 448 presses, the weekly gift pays once (double tap, reload, second tab), all nine sets can be completed and are recorded with their toast, and the gift box gives one answer per thing per day. A save made on production (1e1c18f) loads with sane defaults.

Five things a player would notice should be fixed before shipping. (1) Outside, a tap on the back-right part of the first or second plot's soil acts on the next plot (4 of 27 soil taps wrong, identical at all three sizes), and a tap where the octopus stands at the fence acts on the first plot. (2) A finished but unclaimed weekly gift disappears silently when Monday comes. (3) A tab left open over midnight and resumed without reload gets no daily gift and the day is not counted for "이번 주에 사흘 들어오기". (4) After another tab changes things, after an import and after "전체 초기화", the 살림 chip, the gift dot, an open 살림 sheet and the plants drawn outside stay stale (after a reset the old plants are still drawn outside even after naming a new octopus). (5) With five tasks done the claim button sits below the fold of the sheet (top at 841 px in a 740 px viewport) and the only other signal is an 8 px brown dot on a brown frame.

The rest are small: keyboard focus drops to the page body after re-roll, claim and "다시 입기"; the re-roll and "다시 입기" chips are 32 px high; a re-roll can hand out "사흘 들어오기" already finished; moving the phone clock back a week and forward pays the same week's gift twice; an ask is counted when the brain fails; a few wording and drawing nits. One item is for the owner (the gift box toast invites asking again tomorrow, and the answer is re-rolled by date).

The machine was heavily loaded throughout (load average 16 to 36 on 4 CPUs), so I report no timing-based finding. Everything is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/ (notes.md, t-*.js scripts, out-*.txt logs, shots/). The merge tree is unchanged (git status shows only the untracked node_modules link) and both test servers are stopped.

findings.title: Garden outside: a tap on part of a plot's soil acts on the neighbouring plot
findings.where: js/scene3d.js:2815-2824 (spotAt picks by distance to the centre of overlapping 2D boxes), js/scene3d.js:4041 (plot hit boxes are 0.75 m tall), js/scene3d.js:4106; the outside view during a walk
findings.what: The three plot buttons are 61x67 px each and overlap their neighbour by 34%. A tap on the visible soil of the first plot, in its back-right part, plants/waters/harvests in the second plot; the same from the second to the third. It should act on the plot whose soil was touched. A wrong tap can spend a seed or harvest a flower in a plot the player did not mean.
findings.evidence: 27 taps on projected soil points per size, 4 wrong at each of 320x568, 360x740, 412x915 (soil offsets +0.2/-0.2 and +0.3/-0.3 m): e.g. 360: tap at 113,418 on plot 1 soil acted on plot 2; 146,436 on plot 2 soil acted on plot 3. Buttons at 360: [67,371,61,67] [100,389,61,67] [133,406,61,67]. Logs: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-garden-360.txt, out-garden-320.txt, out-garden-412.txt (same folder). Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/shots/garden-out-360.png
findings.repro: export NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g); serve the tree on 127.0.0.1:8611; PHASE=map SZ=360x740 node /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/t-garden2.js
findings.suggested_fix: Hit-test plots in 3D instead of by 2D box centres: raycast against the three soil boxes (or their ground quads) and take the nearest hit; or keep the 2D boxes but lower them to about 0.2 m and choose by distance to the projected soil centre, not the box centre.

findings.title: A finished but unclaimed weekly gift disappears when the week changes
findings.where: js/app.js:4288-4294 (weekState resets the week when the key differs); 살림 sheet
findings.what: With five tasks done on Sunday and the gift not yet claimed, opening the game on Monday shows a new list and the gift is gone without a word. The sheet says "못 해도 잃는 건 없어", but an earned gift is lost. It should be paid (or kept claimable) when the week rolls over.
findings.evidence: Sun 2026-11-15: key 2026-11-09, 5 done, dot shown, shells 18 seeds 4. Mon 2026-11-16: key 2026-11-16, no dot, shells 21 seeds 5 (only the daily +3/+1). Log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-week-logic.txt (section W4)
findings.suggested_fix: In weekState, before replacing an old week that has weekDoneN >= 5 and claimed false, add the gift and show one quiet toast ("지난주 선물: 조개 12 · 씨앗 2"); or pay automatically when the fifth task is done.

findings.title: A tab left open over midnight gets no daily gift and the day is not counted for the three-days task
findings.where: js/app.js:4444 (dailyGift runs only 2.5 s after boot) and js/app.js:4187 (first naming); visibilitychange handler near js/app.js:4167 calls checkDay but not dailyGift
findings.what: On a phone the tab usually stays alive and is resumed next day without a reload. Then dailyGift never runs: no shells/seed for that day and the day is missing from u.days, so "이번 주에 사흘 들어오기" does not move. dailyGift itself is from production, but the new weekly task now depends on it.
findings.evidence: Booted on 2027-01-05, moved the date to 2027-01-06, fired visibilitychange hidden then visible, waited 4 s: days end with 2027-01-05, giftDay 2027-01-05, row still "이번 주에 사흘 들어오기 2/3". Log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-week-logic.txt (section W5)
findings.suggested_fix: Call dailyGift() from the visibilitychange handler when the page becomes visible (and from checkDay when the day really changed), after the intro is gone.

findings.title: 살림 chip, gift dot, open sheet and the plants outside are not redrawn after a second tab, an import or a full reset
findings.where: js/app.js:2941 (renderAll does not call renderBagChip / applyGarden / applyDye), js/app.js:2045 takeRemote, js/app.js:3655 importJSON, js/app.js:3672 resetAll
findings.what: The saved state is right, but the screen is not. Second tab: after tab A earned shells, planted and claimed, tab B still shows "조개 3", the gift dot, a claim button in its open sheet (pressing it pays nothing, which is right) and an empty garden outside. Import: chip shows "조개 3" for a save with 40 shells and no dot although 5/5 is unclaimed. Full reset: the chip stays visible with the old "조개 40" on top of the name dialog, and the old sprout and seed are still drawn outside even after a new octopus is named (save says empty garden).
findings.evidence: Tab B: scene [null,null,null] vs save with a green seed; chip "조개 3" vs 11. Reset: bagVisible true, chip "조개 40", scene garden [{#c8323a,water 1},{#e8a93a,water 0},null] while user is null; after naming again save garden [null,null,null], scene unchanged. Import: chip "조개 3", dot false with shells 40 and five tasks done. Logs: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-misc-b.txt and out-week-logic.txt (W3). Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/shots/after-reset.png
findings.suggested_fix: Add one function (renderBagChip(); applyGarden(); applyDye(); re-render the 살림 and sewing sheets if open) and call it from takeRemote, importJSON and resetAll (or from renderAll).

findings.title: The claim button is below the fold and the gift dot is hard to see
findings.where: js/app.js:4328 (button appended after the seven rows), css/style.css:1598 (.bag-tag.has-gift::after), index.html:133 (#btn-bag has no label for the gift state)
findings.what: When five tasks are done and the 살림 sheet opens at 360x740, "주간 선물 받기" starts at y 841 in a 740 px viewport; the visible part only says "(5/5)". The other signal is an 8 px dot coloured #884b2b sitting on the chip's dark brown frame, which reads as part of the frame, and the chip's accessible name stays "조개 3". Together with F2 a player can easily never collect the gift.
findings.evidence: claim button {top 841, bottom 905, viewport 740}; dot computed 8x8 px rgb(136,75,43) at top -3 right -3; aria-label null. Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/shots/week-claim-360.png and shots/chip-dot-360-x4.png. Log: out-final.txt in the same folder
findings.suggested_fix: Put the claim button right under the "(5/5)" line, above the list; give the dot a contrasting colour with a light rim, and add the state to the chip's aria-label ("살림, 주간 선물이 있어").

findings.title: Keyboard focus falls to the page body after re-roll, claim and "다시 입기"
findings.where: js/app.js:4308 (weekReroll -> renderBag), js/app.js:4312 (weekClaim), js/app.js:4362 (setWear -> renderSew)
findings.what: Each of these rebuilds the whole sheet, so the pressed button is destroyed and document.activeElement becomes body. The next Tab starts again from the first chip. Focus should return to the same row's control (or the row).
findings.evidence: re-roll on row 7: focus "body" (twice, 360 and 320); claim: focus "body"; 다시 입기: focus "body". Logs: out-final.txt, out-sets-320.txt and the t-recheck.js run in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/
findings.suggested_fix: After the re-render, focus the chip of the same row index, or the row's text with tabindex -1 when the chip is gone; after claim, focus the "이번 주 선물은 받았어." line.

findings.title: Re-roll and "다시 입기" chips are 32 px high
findings.where: css/style.css:1597 (.week-row .week-rr { min-height: 36px } is overridden; computed min-height 32px)
findings.what: The chips measure 88x32 (바꾸기 n) and 94x32 (다시 입기), under the 44 px tap target the project uses. Rows are 44 px or taller, so neighbours are not close, but the target itself is small.
findings.evidence: getBoundingClientRect: 88x32 and 94x32; computed minHeight "32px", class "fchip week-rr". Logs: out-final.txt, out-sets-320.txt in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/
findings.suggested_fix: Give .week-rr min-height 44px with a selector that wins in the pixel theme (:root[data-font="pixel"] .week-row .week-rr).

findings.title: A re-roll can hand out "이번 주에 사흘 들어오기" already finished
findings.where: js/app.js:4284-4287 (weekPick), js/app.js:4296 (questN reads u.days), js/app.js:4305-4309
findings.what: Progress of the days task is read from the days already recorded, not from the row. With three days in this week, a re-roll that lands on it shows "했어" at once and counts toward the five. The rule "a re-roll starts from 0 and never gives a finished task" does not hold for this one kind.
findings.evidence: Week 2026-11-16, days 11-16, 11-17, 11-18: second press on row 1 gave "이번 주에 사흘 들어오기했어", note "(1/5)". Log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-final.txt
findings.suggested_fix: In weekReroll, add 'days' to the taken list when its count for this week is already 3.

findings.title: Phone clock set back a week and forward again: the week's progress is wiped and the same week pays its gift twice
findings.where: js/app.js:4290 (any different week key replaces the stored week, including its claimed flag)
findings.what: After claiming in week 2026-11-23, opening the sheet with the date in the week before and then back gives a fresh list with claimed false; five tasks later the gift pays again. The honest side of the same thing: a clock that goes back (travel, manual change) erases this week's progress.
findings.evidence: first claim: shells 12 seeds 2; clock back: key 2026-11-16; forward: key 2026-11-23 claimed false, all 0; second claim: shells 24 seeds 4. Log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-final.txt
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the last few claimed week keys (u.weekPaid = [key…]) and refuse a second claim for a key in it; do not replace the stored week when the new key is earlier than the stored one.

findings.title: An ask is counted when the brain fails and no turn happens
findings.where: js/app.js:1718 (questMark('ask') before B.plan resolves; the failure branch at js/app.js:1736-1739 removes the trip but not the count)
findings.what: When the plan fails the trip is removed and the toast says "두뇌가 잠깐 멈췄어. 다시 한 번 불러 줘", but "문어한테 산책 갈지 묻기" has already moved by one.
findings.evidence: BRAIN.plan forced to reject: ask 0 -> 1, trips 0 -> 0. Log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-final.txt
findings.suggested_fix: Move questMark('ask') into the branch where the plan came back.

findings.title: Task "부엌 방 들르기" is done by entering the room the game calls "놀이방"
findings.where: js/app.js:4280 (task text), js/app.js:544 (counted when the view becomes 'play'), index.html:115 (door label "놀이방")
findings.what: Nothing on screen is called "부엌 방"; the door says "놀이방". A player has to guess which room is meant. The count itself works.
findings.evidence: Entering through #btn-door (label 놀이방): kitchen 0 -> 1. Log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-week-actions.txt
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the task to "놀이방 들르기" (or "놀이방 부엌 들르기").

findings.title: Doubled word in the "다락방 차림" set: "다락방 차림 차림으로 입었어"
findings.where: js/app.js:4362 (toast q[1] + ' 차림으로 입었어'), js/app.js:4370 (aria-label q[1] + ' 차림 다시 입기'), js/app.js:4352 (set name '다락방 차림')
findings.what: The set name already ends in "차림", so the toast and the button label repeat it.
findings.evidence: label "다락방 차림 차림 다시 입기", toast "다락방 차림 차림으로 입었어" (t-recheck.js output; also out-sets-320.txt in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/)
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the set ("다락방" or "다락방 평소") or build the two strings without the extra "차림" when the name ends with it.

findings.title: Garden drawing: a planted seed is a dot of about 4x3 px, and the fence runs through the first plot
findings.where: js/scene3d.js:4050 (seed mound in the wood colour on dark soil), js/scene3d.js:4034 (PLOT.xs / z 2.3) against the fence line ending at x 0.8, z 2.66 (js/scene3d.js:3885)
findings.what: After planting outside, the only change in the picture is a small olive dot on the dark soil; on a phone it is easy to miss, so the plot looks empty until the first watering. Separately, the yard fence's rail and end post stand inside the soil of the first plot.
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/shots/garden-empty-vs-seed-360.png (4x enlargement, empty left, seed in the middle plot right); shots/garden-sheet-360.png (seed, sprout, flower and the six colours: all six colours are distinguishable)
findings.suggested_fix: Draw the seed as a lighter mound with a visible two-leaf sprout tip or a small marker stick; shift the plots about 0.5 m to +x or shorten the fence by one segment.

findings.title: Plot buttons' labels never say what is in the plot or what a press will do
findings.where: index.html:137-139 (aria-label "텃밭 첫째 칸", title "텃밭"); js/app.js:4425 (sheet plot buttons have no label; text nodes run together)
findings.what: The outside plot buttons are reachable by keyboard and Enter works, but the label stays "텃밭 셋째 칸" whether the plot is empty, seeded or in flower. The sheet's plot buttons read as "씨앗물 주기", "파랑 꽃거두기" (state and action glued together; that part is the same on production).
findings.evidence: label after planting: "텃밭 셋째 칸"; sheet buttons text "씨앗물 주기", "새싹물 주기", "파랑 꽃거두기", aria none. Logs: out-misc-a.txt and the PHASE=play run of t-garden2.js in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/
findings.repro: PHASE=play node /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/t-garden2.js; ONLY=reload node t-misc.js (same folder)
findings.suggested_fix: Set aria-label in applyGarden / renderBag: "텃밭 첫째 칸, 새싹, 물 주기".

findings.title: 2D fallback: the sheet says the plots can be tapped outside, but there are none
findings.where: js/app.js:4421 (note text), js/scene2d.js:171 (SPOT_BOX has no plots)
findings.what: With ?scene=2d the 살림 sheet still says "문어가 산책 나가 바깥이 보일 때는 밭을 바로 톡 해도 돼", yet no plot button ever appears during a walk. The garden in the sheet works.
findings.evidence: 2D: plant, water, refuse through the sheet OK; during the walk place went attic -> exterior, plot buttons ever shown: false. Log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-misc-a.txt
findings.suggested_fix: Show the second sentence only when sceneMode is '3d'.

findings.title: Gift box: a reload right after pressing "내밀기" uses up the day's question without an answer
findings.where: js/app.js:3242-3249 (the thing is marked as asked at once; the answer is rolled and applied 1.3 s later in a timer)
findings.what: If the page is reloaded or closed inside the 1.3 s pause, the save says the thing was asked today, but no answer was shown, logged or applied. A second try says "오늘은 이미 물어봤어".
findings.evidence: Reload 0 s after offering 밀짚모자: saved giftAsked {day 2026-11-13, ids {strawhat:1}}, second try "오늘은 이미 물어봤어. 내일 다시 물어볼 수 있어". Seen once, and it follows directly from the code. Log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-gift.txt
findings.suggested_fix: Roll the answer at once and store it with the mark (ids[gk] = 'yes' | 'no', wear applied in the same save); keep only the showing in the timer. A repeated ask could then show the same answer again instead of a bare refusal.

findings.title: A save with an unknown flower colour makes the 살림 sheet throw and not open
findings.where: js/app.js:4424 (dyeOf(g.color)[1] on null), js/app.js:4335 (gardenAct), js/app.js:4331 (applyGarden, caught), js/app.js:4252 (userState does not check garden entries)
findings.what: Only with a hand-edited or damaged save (or a save from a later build with a new colour): pressing the 살림 chip throws TypeError before the sheet is shown, so the weekly list and the garden cannot be opened. importJSON accepts such a file (its trial render does not cover the sheet). A wholly broken user block, by contrast, is repaired fine.
findings.evidence: pageerror: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading '1') at app.js:4424:58 (renderBag) and at app.js:4335:115 (gardenAct). Log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-misc-b.txt
findings.suggested_fix: In userState, turn any garden entry that is not an object with a known colour into null (or give it the first colour), and clamp water to 0..2.

findings.title: A tap on the octopus at the fence spot outside acts on the first plot
findings.where: js/scene3d.js:4106 (plots are tested before the octopus), js/scene3d.js:3874 (spot 'numbers' at x 0, z 1.7 next to plot 1)
findings.what: The first plot's 0.75 m tall hit box covers the place where the octopus stands when it visits the fence. A tap there plants or waters instead of doing nothing. I tested the screen position, not with the octopus actually standing there; the order of tests in pick() makes its presence irrelevant.
findings.evidence: 412x915: world (0, 0.25, 1.7) -> screen 125,504 -> plot 1 planted; (0, 0.55, 1.7) -> 125,490 -> plot 1 planted. Log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/out-garden-412.txt
findings.suggested_fix: Same fix as F1 (3D hit test on the soil); or test the octopus first.

findings.what: With the intro showing, the toast "오늘 선물: 조개 3 · 씨앗 1" is shown 2.5 s after boot beneath the intro layer and is gone before the intro ends. The 살림 chip and the plot buttons are correctly hidden during the intro. Production (1e1c18f) behaves the same.
findings.evidence: New build: toast text captured during phase sky (out-misc-a.txt). Old build: toast rect [16,568,328,76], element on top at that point is #intro; screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/shots/intro-toast-old.png
findings.repro: node /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-features/t-intro-toast.js (timing dependent: the new build's toast was caught in t-misc.js but missed in this script's polling)

findings.title: Gift box: the refusal toast invites asking again tomorrow, and tomorrow's answer is a new roll
findings.where: js/app.js:3243 (toast "오늘은 이미 물어봤어. 내일 다시 물어볼 수 있어"), js/app.js:3246 (seed = date + thing + name, 65% yes)
findings.what: The change makes a "no" stand for the day, which works. But the answer is re-rolled by date, and the toast tells the player they can ask again tomorrow, so a "no" turns into a "yes" by asking daily (리본: no on 11-11, yes on 11-12 in my run). Options: (a) leave as is: simple, and each day's answer is honest about being a demo rule; (b) drop the second sentence of the toast so the game does not suggest the retry: one string; (c) let a "no" for a thing stand for the week or until the player offers something else: closer to "the octopus decided", costs a little more state.
